servedAt: the brand feedback portals (PaiKaan, qcaddy and rerolla)

patches.summary: Digest-pinned native build/runtime
Shared server-only OpenAI headers (string|null) and actual OpenRouter no-train across every AI client
Complete native Thai locale pinned from upstream PR692
One-use bound SSO, ACK, native idempotent Tickets, host launcher
Owner-bound private evidence with durable PostgreSQL/D1 binding holds, scan, expiry and authenticated streaming
Native header/hop resolver needs peer admission on exposed CF origin
Fail closed before any native migration on unknown, holey or legacy ledger lineage
Withheld under coordinated disclosure; published when the embargo ends.
Retire admin-only; preserve legacy protected subtrees as native private and retain public viewer guards
Close provider diagnostics in exact native AI clients, retry logs, usage and tracing while preserving internal error and fallback behavior
Owner-authorized committed private attachment deletion retains Ticket and immutable binding with durable PG/D1 read fences
Explicit native widget provenance compatible with retained legacy enum/HMAC constraints; historical rows remain unchanged
Explicit Workers AI low effort on structured chat and public synthesis; retain legacy OpenRouter semantics
Independent Customer Agent Workers AI route preserves Copilot and embedding configuration; no global fallback
Use Chat Completions-compatible fields for exact gpt-6-luna calls without changing model selection, provider policy, or other models

Generic native-1 upload-attachment stores identified host Blob bytes as Quackback files through the widget upload pipeline; native create-ticket links at most ten of the requester's own uploads to the opening message

Default-off support retention: a daily job deletes closed (and optionally idle) support conversations with their finished customer tickets, soft-deleted tickets and messages, and file tombstones past SUPPORT_RETENTION_CLOSED_DAYS, honouring a hold tag; files orphaned by it lose their bytes through native file-retention. A plan/apply support-erase command erases one person's support data behind a plan token

Review follow-up for native upload-attachment intake: a {fileId}-only attachment entry is complete (url/size optional; the ticket core rebuilds every field from the file row) and a reused submissionId with a different report returns the closed native code SUBMISSION_CONFLICT

Widget Home UX: the profile card opened from the header avatar floats above the body on an opaque popover surface (header row z-30 above the z-10 body, card z-[60] bg-popover); the host-armed native-1 Report action leads the Home card list as a standard action card (icon tile, host label, localized subtitle widget.native.capture.sub) with the unchanged capture-config contract, enabled/origin guard and native-capture-request message

Evidence-broker retirement: remove the five native-1 broker commands (evidence-capability, bind-evidence, abort-evidence, read-evidence, delete-evidence), their facade variants/handlers and brp_/qbe_ id schemas, the private-evidence and capability-introspection routes, the broker modules and the widget private-evidence accessory; keep capture-config, upload-attachment and every migration (0294/0295/0297 and 0298 where present) so the ledger stays an exact prefix
Keep explicit private downloads on the Quackback origin so embedding-host frame-src policy cannot block a bucket redirect

Upstream QuackbackIO/quackback#806 (head 745fa4a16c, still open upstream): the admin changelog shipped-post picker orders by updatedAt DESC (then votes, createdAt) with a 100-row default, and linked posts outside that window or reopened out of a complete status stay visible via includeIds instead of being silently dropped on save

Upstream QuackbackIO/quackback#812 (head ef1b8a583, building on #806): expose and accept featuredImageUrl across POST/PATCH /api/v1/changelog, formatChangelogResponse, OpenAPI schemas and MCP create_changelog/update_changelog, and preserve an already-published entry historical publishedAt when updating with publishState.type=published without an explicit publishAt
